tool.name: RADAR-PD CIF Library Builder
tool.description: build a reusable mini or augmented candidate library
tool.command: set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p cif_inputs library_output && #for $index, $cif_file in enumerate($cif_files) ln -s '$cif_file' 'cif_inputs/candidate_${index}.cif' && #end for python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py build-library \ --cif-dir cif_inputs \ --library-mode '$library_mode' \ --radiation '$radiation' \ #if str($library_mode) == 'augmented' --base-db-root "${RADAR_PD_DB_ROOT}/database_${radiation}" \ #end if --output-root library_output \ --manifest-output '$library_manifest' \ --archive '$library_archive' \ $overwrite \ > >(tee -a '$console_output') 2> >(tee -a '$console_output' >&2)
tool.help: Builds a portable RADAR-PD library from a Galaxy list collection of CIF files. "Only my CIFs" creates a compact standalone library. "Built-in + my CIFs" requires the NDIP deployment to mount the matching built-in catalog read-only in the RADAR-PD container. The resulting ZIP can be selected as the candidate library in RADAR-PD Analyze and preserved in Galaxy history for reuse.
